author: bfonta
body:
CMSSW includes two extremely similar MHT producers which are used in different places for the same task. `HLTHtMhtProducer` is essentially a generalization of `HLTMhtProducer`. I kept the former.
On top, I moved a check to the constructor for efficiency, and I added a doc-string detailing what MHT and HT are.
title: Unify MHT producers.
